It is legally enforced in India by the Agricultural Produce (Grading and Marking) Act of 1937 (and amended in 1986). The present AGMARK standards cover quality guidelines for different commodities spanning a variety of Pulses, Cereals, Essential Oils, vegetable oils, Fruits & Vegetables, and semi-processed products like Vermicelli. Gold hallmarking A stamp that allows consumers to know the purity of gold jewellery.

question.content: National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation (NBCFDC) is a Government of India undertaking under the aegis of the Ministry of _

solution.content: Social justice and empowerment. National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC) was incorporated under Section 25 of the Companies Act 1956 on 13th January 1992. Objective To promote economic and developmental activities for the benefit of Other Backward Classes (OBCs) and to assist the poorer section of these classes in skill development and self-employment ventures.

question.content: In which year was Operation Flood started with an aim to create a nationwide milk grid?

solution.content: 1970. Dr. Verghese Kurien (father of white revolution in India) launched this Operation, to increase the pace of white revolution. Other Important revolutions of India - Black Revolution (Petroleum), Golden Revolution (Horticulture and Honey), Grey Revolution (Fertilizer), Blue Revolution (Fish), Silver Revolution (Eggs), Red Revolution (Meat and Tomato), Golden Fibre Revolution (Jute Production), Green Revolution (Agricultural Production), Pink Revolution (Onions).

question.content: What is the term used for perks that employers give to their employees above and beyond any financial compensation?

solution.content: Fringe benefits are the additional benefits offered to an employee, above the stated salary for the performance of a specific service. Examples: Education reduction, Stock options, Retirement planning services etc. Marginal benefit is the maximum amount that a customer is willing to pay for an additional unit of good or service.

question.content: is an Islamic finance term referring to the obligation that an individual has to donate a certain proportion of wealth each year to charitable causes.

solution.content: Zakat. Mudarabah is a partnership where one party provides the capital while the other provides labor and both share in the profits. Ijarah denotes a contract where one party transfers the right to use an item he owns to another party for a specified period in exchange for an agreed consideration. Musharakah is a joint partnership arrangement in Islamic finance in which profits and losses are shared.

question.content: Which of the following alternatives is NOT a source of formal data on unemployment in India?

options.text: Reports by Directorate General of Employment
Reports of National Family Health Survey

Questions.answer: Reports of National Family Health Survey

solution.content: The NFHS is a large-scale, multi-round survey conducted in representative sample of households throughout India. Three sources of data on unemployment (1) Reports of Census of India (2) National Sample Survey Organisation's Reports of Employment and Unemployment Situation (3) Directorate General of Employment and Training Data of Registration with Employment Exchanges. Though they provide different estimates of unemployment, they do provide us with the attributes of the unemployed and the unemployment scenario prevailing in our country.

question.content: Which of the following is the consumer complaint body of the Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI)?

solution.content: Consumer Complaints Council (CCC). It is ASCI's heart and soul. This collection of distinguished individuals has provided significant momentum to ASCI's activities and self-regulation in advertising.

question.content: Which of the following is an economic situation in which all-available labour resources are being used in the most efficient way possible?

solution.content: Full employment. Under employment - It is a measure of the total number of people in an economy who are unwillingly working in low-skill and low-paying jobs or only part-time because they cannot get full-time jobs that use their skills. Example Medical graduate working as pizza delivery man.

question.content: Which of the following statements about real wage rate is correct?

options.text: Real wage rate is equal to the Marginal Productivity of Labour.
Real wage rate is less than the Marginal Productivity of Labour.
Real wage rate has no relation to Marginal Productivity of Labour.
Real wage rate is more than the Marginal Productivity of Labour.

Questions.answer: Real wage rate is equal to the Marginal Productivity of Labour.

solution.content: A real wage rate is a nominal wage rate divided by the price of a good and is a transparent measure of how much of the good an hour of work buys. It provides an important indicator of the living standards of workers, and also of the productivity of workers.
